description: Implementation of a message transmitter class for handling Ethernet frame bursts, message queuing, and transmission timing in a network system.

classes.name: message_transmitter_impl
classes.description: Class responsible for managing Ethernet frame bursts, message queuing, and transmission in a network system.

methods.name: transmit_frame_burst
methods.description: Sends a burst of Ethernet frames via the Ethernet transmitter.

methods.name: enqueue_messages_into_burst
methods.description: Enqueues pending messages into a burst for transmission, with logging and tracing.

methods.name: on_new_symbol
methods.description: Handles new symbol events, enqueues control and user plane messages, and transmits the resulting burst.

methods.name: get_ethernet_transmitter
methods.description: Returns a reference to the Ethernet transmitter object.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns a reference to the metrics collector object.
